title: MAKING OUR FACE HARDER THAN THEIR FACE

sense.text:
“For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning.” Everything written aforetime by our God and our forefathers was instructions given to us.

“That we through patience”: this is not a swift race. You have to pace yourself. Some people might fall, but you have to get back into the fight again.

“And comfort of the scriptures”: we find our comfort in the scriptures. That is why we make it our business 24/7, not giving the wicked of our people any rest; they constantly hear the word of God and the good news being professed.

“Might have hope.” We need that hope right now, especially now, because the wicked amongst our people and the wicked of the nations are gearing up for battle. Some of our people do not even think they are in captivity; they are complacent with the 9 to 5, the bonus, the big house, the Chick-fil-A, at ease in Babylon. But that time is over. The Lord is stirring it up. Satan has handpicked his champion, Trump, but the wicked of our people still have yet to choose theirs. We have to let it be known who is our God, who is our king, and what is our constitution: the Bible is our constitution, and this is where we find our peace and our comfort.

“Good is set against evil, and life against death.” This world is full of death; the only thing that has life is the scriptures, that hope.

“So is the godly against the sinner, and the sinner against the godly.” This is the battle we are in today, our daily fight. The ungodly are powering up right now: invading one another, creating laws to come against each other, mustering up for the battle to come against us, while a lot of our people are still in La La Land and do not know what is coming.

So which side do you choose? Are you going to be a servant of the Lord, which leads into life, or a servant of Satan?

precepts.why:
This is the contract of the battle: “Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse.” “A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the Lord your God”: if you want to enlist with the Lord, you have to obey the commandments. “And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the Lord your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.”

It is set right before you, like the blue pill and the red pill. One awakens you out of your slumber and introduces you to the way that leads into the path of life. The other keeps you asleep, to die with the rest of them. You can live it up and party it up, or you can choose to suffer with your people, which leads straight to life, and be used by God to go into those dark ghettos and wake up the young brother and the young sister that depend on you. It is up to you.

sense.text:
“Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel.” Read the scriptures over and over: the prophets are set on a mission to their own people, dispatched to them through generation after generation, and the mission is still in full effect.

“That hath rebelled against me”: they chose the red pill, rejected the life and the commandments, and chose this world. “They and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.” 2026, this very day, we are still in the midst of that same battle. That is why the prophets have been dispatched again.

“For they are impudent children and stiffhearted.” Some of our people are so hard-headed they will hear this good news and reject it; they love this wicked world so much that they turn their backs on life.

“Whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear,” we do not care: the Lord has already set it and is letting us know, preparing us. And it hurts when they do not listen. Mom, you shouldn’t be eating that pork, the Lord said don’t do it; and she says, boy, leave me alone. We know that hurts.

“For they are a rebellious house,” and the Lord knows what he created. “Yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them”: they will know it when they are getting jacked up. The scriptures are the only thing that gives us hope, a guideline; a people without a guide is led into darkness and chaos. The Lord gives comfort right there: they are going to find out, so keep doing what you are doing. Do not stop preaching the word and giving them the correction.

“Be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words.” Our people are full of words: they will cuss the hell out of you and are quick to slander you. Come with the words of righteousness, telling them they are God’s chosen people, to repent, put down the guns, raise their children and marry their wives, and they hate us for it. You are going to get cussed out, slandered, snitched on at work with your Facebook page shown to the boss. The Lord said do not be afraid of that.

“Though briers and thorns be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions”: scorpions are very poisonous, and he is comparing them to the wicked. You are around the poisonous that can kill you; when we go out to camp, in the highways and byways, we are risking our lives.

“Nor be dismayed at their looks.” Dismay is to be shocked, disappointed, disheartened or distressed by bad news. This is what happens to brothers who are not grounded: they can slaughter John 3:16 in camp 101, but on the corner the crowd rises up against them, they look to the side for somebody to save them, all the scriptures leave their brain, and now they want to lay hands on a person. You will be shocked when the crowd says, who you talking to? We trying to twerk. Disappointed and disheartened because the bulk of them do not believe. Distressed when your family says you are making things hot, or your job calls you in for a meeting about this purple and gold thing. That is why the pressure is put on in camp 101.

“And thou shalt speak my words.” But how are you going to speak his words if you have not mastered them? If you have not studied to show yourself approved, and you do not have the genuine spirit to use the words of the Lord to wake up the drug dealer and get the harlot out of those pants and into a modest dress, but only want to cut up a Christian and be in the high places, you are going to be confounded and dismayed by them.

precepts.why:
“Study to shew thyself approved unto God”: not unto man, but unto God. He is the one that makes the selections, calling you up out of the sin, the drug dealing and the nastiness, to get cleaned up and master this.

“A workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.” You have a nation depending on you; you have been activated within that perimeter. Your wicked family members breaking the laws of God, your homeboy you used to do wickedness with, are depending on you to wake them up and give them the message so their souls are not snatched away. So you have to show yourself approved, and “shun profane and vain babblings.”

That is why we go straight back to Ezekiel 2: the brother who has not studied to show himself approved is the one who gets dismayed when the crowd turns on him, because he never mastered what he must speak.

sense.text: “For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.” The Lord gives us good doctrine, doctrines of life, the very words the people hate.
“Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.” So the doctrine is the laws of God, the commandments of God.

“Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.” To decline is to pull back and fall away. We have brothers and sisters who were introduced to their mighty heritage, that they are the Israelites, the children of God, the sons of God, and then the cares of this world and the lust of the flesh took them out of here; they took their hand off the plow.

Then come the complaints: I’m overwhelmed, Cap. There is no better place to be overwhelmed than for the Lord. You will invest more into your 9 to 5 than into the Lord, then call it overwhelming to edit videos to wake up your people or to teach the brother brand new in the truth. That is a shame. The Lord is constantly looking for those who will understand and retain the knowledge, and then be dispatched to wake up the lost.

“Wisdom is the principal thing”: it is the main thing. “Therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.” They go hand in hand. You hear thou shalt not steal; the understanding is, I used to walk in that lifestyle and I am not going to do it anymore. Now you can be used to teach the next brother battling the same thing.

You do not let it go in one ear and out the other, and you do not let wisdom sit just within you: you learn it and then apply it. There are no professional students here. Come in, get involved, and join the curriculum set in place to make us better men, better fathers and better leaders.

precepts.why:
“Neither decline from the words of my mouth.” You might think that means the Lord will descend from the sky and speak to you with his mouth, but the mouth of God is this Bible. And who is he using to edify the people?

“Nevertheless we have not hearkened unto the voice of the Lord our God, according unto all the words of the prophets”: the prophets are who is teaching. That is who the Lord uses to bring out his word as it is written. So once you come into this truth and put on the purple shirt, you have to go ahead and prophesy and teach the people. Never forget that.

Learning these laws is not all you have to do. Learning them is part of getting rid of 20, 30, 40, 50 years of BS, the gunk of Christianity that says God said don’t do this, but we can do whatever we want.

“The fear of the Lord is all wisdom”: God says thou shalt not, and you must fear breaking the word of the king. In a regular sense, if the king decrees something and you go against it, it is your behind. God’s decree is this Bible: if we do it, we have to know there is a punishment for it.

“And in all wisdom is the performance of the law.” When you learn thou shalt not, thou shalt, love thy brother, go into all the world and teach, God says perform it. When the sky cracks and the black Messiah comes with the legions of angels, practice time is over. Whether you have been in this truth six months or longer, you had better have been performing the law, because then there is no more Lord, please forgive me. It is death, moved out of the way for the people who were serious.

“And the knowledge of his omnipotency.” He knows the end from the beginning. If the kingdom of heaven was made with twelve gates, the twelve tribes of Israel, then before he made Adam, before a tree or a goat, he knew his people would be in the place he created. So how can everybody fit in there?

sense.text:
You have to see the importance of studying to show yourself approved: mastering the scriptures and applying them. “So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.” You hear the law, thou shalt not; then comes what it means and when you apply it. Thou shalt not steal: where is the scripture, and when do you apply it?

That is why we have to master these scriptures, because you will be tried. Look at the video of a man testing people’s integrity with an envelope of money: a woman claimed it as hers, the woman next to her cosigned the lie, and then she lied again to cover it. The wicked move in bulk. And the little boy with her learned an evil lesson; you could see his countenance change. These are your Christians, your church mothers.

“Concerning propitiation, be not without fear to add sin unto sin.” You see how the thing escalated: from lying that it was her money, to her sister lying for her, to I was going to bring it to the counter. You get caught up in one sin, and now you have to lie to cover it up. Once that money is tucked in, it is going to the house.

“And say not His mercy is great; he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins.” That is what a Christian would say: no matter how much sin I keep committing, he will give me mercy. But without repenting, how would you receive mercy? You have to confess, then repent.

“For mercy and wrath come from him.” Christians say he is merciful but forget the wrath part. He is a God of love, but he is also a God of judgment, and the Lord loves judgment. You want to be found as one of the judges, not on the opposite end of it.

precepts.why:
“That ye may walk honestly.” A so-called follower of Christ has to walk honestly. Now the church mother is caught on camera, it goes through the whole community, and she walks into church on Sunday with them knowing she was the one rolling on the floor and yelling at the little baby, now in the line for the Easter eggs.

Those are the ones who will cuss us out and say, don’t judge me, go bother the white neighborhood. But if we do not stop you now, you could go to jail: that was stealing, maybe someone’s bill money, and your integrity is out the window. Imagine brothers and sisters in Israel caught the same way: no, I didn’t steal that cell phone. Run it back. Your words and your actions must match.

“Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth”: no more I’m covered by the blood, I’m a Christian. “For the Lord is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.”

Your actions follow who you truly worship. If you worship Caesar Borgia, sodomy, debauchery and all manner of wickedness follow. If you truly follow the God of this Bible, your actions will follow. They are weighed every day: when you wake up you choose to continue on the path of righteousness or fall back, and there is a judgment waiting.

There is no hypocrisy with the Lord; he will devour you and cast you before the congregation. So the brothers going out in the highways and byways teaching our people to repent must not stop, and must stay on their A game, because Satan is always on his.

sense.text:
Look at the United Nations vote declaring the enslavement of Africans the gravest crime against humanity: 123 for, and three against, America, Argentina and Israel. Slavery is on the topic because the watchmen are on their A game, pushing this truth through the four corners. We are the slaves the nations dragged and used to build their cities, and the Lord is not letting the nations forget.

“All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not.” That is why they voted against it. To them, destroying us and taking our culture was nothing: we did nothing wrong to y’all. The US said it does not recognize reparations for wrongs that were not illegal at the time, and that Trump has done more for black Americans than any other president, when our community is so dilapidated.

“Because they have sinned against the Lord”: it is your fault, they say, and that is how they are. “The habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers.”

The book New World Jewry shows it: the Jews were the largest ship chandlers in the Caribbean, the ships owned by Jews, manned by Jewish crews and sailed under Jewish captains, many of them bringing slaves from Africa; Jews were traders and masters, blacks were merchandise and slaves. Our bodies were part of that merchandise. That is Amalek, and that is why they are on the list voting against it. And a Negro has the audacity to ask, where are the ships at? Satan is on his A game.

The Lord is not going to let them forget; he constantly reminds them. And we are going to keep reminding you over and over. The same way you are hard-headed against hearing the word of God and the commandments of God, we are going to be hard-headed with this truth. We will double up.

precepts.why:
“Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law”: “therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.” That is the curse of Deuteronomy 28:15-68. We violated the contract cast before our forefathers, after we all said yes to the commandments of God.

“And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us”, “by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.” A great evil was done to Israel, a mark set upon the chosen people. Everybody suffered some form of slavery, but not the type we did: our names erased, our women raped, the sex trafficking that is still going on to this day. And you want to be coerced with the Chick-fil-A and your bonus at your 9 to 5? The whole nations are talking about it, because the Lord is not going to let them forget.

They hate you, and they have systems in place to keep you oppressed, generation after generation: black codes, Jim Crow, convict leasing, laws set up to put you in prison and then lease out your labor. We show you over and over, but you do not want to believe it.

“Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” “Though he humble himself, and go crouching”: his humbling is lying and deceiving you. Here is the stimulus check, the HUD housing, section 8, food stamps, a high-paying job, a scholarship, then making you the boss: we’re all the same. “Yet take good heed and beware of him”: be careful. His rust has not been “altogether wiped away.”

“Set him not by thee.” Do not put him by you, and do not envy his wealth and his power, because the power reserved for us is unimaginable.

sense.text:
This is why the nations are talking about us, about slavery and who they caused this harm to. They are trying to wash their hands, but the Lord is not going to let them forget. “What nation hath not had a part in her kingdom and gotten of her spoils?” Almost every kingdom had their hand in our demise and enslavement.

So the Lord keeps reminding them, and uses his servants to go out in the highways. We have to keep preaching this gospel, teaching the atrocities done to us, and pulling our people up out of the fire. The Lord does not want to destroy his people; he wants their deliverance. But some of them are so hard-headed they have to go.

precepts.why:
Every kingdom had its hand on us. Our forefathers saw this and cried, “Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God”: Lord, do something. “For, lo, thine enemies”: they hate us, and they make it known over and over with their systems.

They fire you and drag you. The working class makes just enough to reach next week, and the bills, the citations, the red-light cameras and speed cameras are lined up in our communities to take it, while Esau’s community has trees, parks, a Trader Joe’s and wellness. In ours there is a Chick-fil-A across from a Burger King. It hurts when our people glorify this kingdom and the white man’s business. That vexes us to keep fighting, toward the light at the end of the tunnel: our kingdom, our rulership.

“They that hate thee have lifted up the head. They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones. They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation.” They made it their business to cut us off from being a nation.

sense.text:
A panel asked what part of America could be improved by making it more like Haiti, after they took Haiti’s gold, killed its president in 1915, saddled it with debt for its revolution and hit it with embargoes, then tell it to stand on its own two feet; as Martin Luther King said, you are telling a bootless man to strap up his boots. They cut the feet off of Haiti and say stand up. It is in their DNA; they are on a mission sent by Satan with blinders on like a horse. But we understand the outcome: the children of light win.

The Lord is manifesting the evil and the righteous, so that we have no excuse as to what path to take, just as Deuteronomy 11:26 sets the choice before us. “So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves”: that is why he was stuttering. They revealed their own evil, that they are the devil the Bible speaks of. “All that see them shall flee away.”

If you Christians still do not know who the devil is, the Bible will reveal him. Paul, by the spirit of Christ, says two things must take place before Christ comes back. “For that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first”: the Israelites of all twelve tribes shall fall, not just two or three tribes, and that happened in 70 AD.

“And that man of sin be revealed”: that is what we are doing right now. The Israelites right now are revealing the devil, and the devil is Amalek, who so-calls himself Jew or Jewish. Then the Lord is going to come. “The son of perdition”: the son of destruction.

“Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God.” That is how you know it is talking about the white man: who today impersonates God, who painted himself as Christ? Caesar Borgia. Paul is telling you who the son of perdition is. We did not paint ourselves as that; we just read what the Bible says Christ looked like.

“So that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God”, and he is worshipped, because the majority of black churches today have a white painted image of Christ.
“Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things? And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed”: revealed in these last days.

Look at the pastor saying God obeys him and calling those who do not obey him stupid, while committing adultery on his wife: he shows which god he serves by his actions. This is what we are up against: the blasphemy of our people. Are you studying to show yourself approved, ready for this battle? If not, he will convince you he is 100 percent right.

“For all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.” Whether in blasphemy in black Christianity or twerking in all forms of debauchery, they are hard-hearted; their conscience is seared.

“Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces”: strong against their wickedness. The Lord says, I am going to have you double up, strong against them, fortified, ready to take down those evildoers. “And thy forehead strong against their foreheads.”

How is it going to be strong? You are going to be well studied, and know how to genuinely apply what you studied, with the wisdom and the understanding hand in hand.

“As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not.” Do not be scared. That is why we show these videos: to prepare you for the battle and harden you against their wickedness. Some see this and get dismayed, disheartened, discouraged, and give it all up: here’s my purple shirt, take my fringes off, then the weed, the phone call to order a woman, the sister taking off the dress and twerking on Facebook. We have seen that.

“Neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.” Israel is a rebellious house, and we are called to be revolutionaries for our people. Examine the revolutionaries: they were all strong, prepared to be imprisoned for what they did for their community. Look at Bobby Seale of the Black Panthers telling of the hole: a seven-by-five box with no bed and a cold floor, the sewage backing up so he had to stand in it until it receded. When you are revolutionary, they cannot break your spirit, and it is the cops who could never take what they do to us. That is how you know there is a strong spirit on the nation of Israel and the true revolutionaries.

precepts.why:
This is the spirit we have to have, and why we must keep the commandments and the good doctrine of Proverbs 4:2. “And the Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.”

If we keep our carnal selves, we will not be able to sustain psychologically what they do to us. But if we keep the commandments and the faith in Christ and are turned into another man, which is the spirit of Christ, then no matter what we go through, we will endure it. This is our lot.

Jeremiah could not stop; it was fire shut up in his bones. That is the course we are set on, our faces hardened with the word of God. Do not take it lightly: most brothers think we are not going through Jacob’s trouble and will be beamed up by the chariots. It is not happening that way. Our forefathers went through the suffering and we have to go through it too; that is the ticket for our salvation, our entrance into the kingdom.

“Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name.” That is Jeremiah experiencing being dismayed at all the work he was set to.

Jeremiah tried to run away from it, and the Lord did not let him. Like most of us, he saw the task at hand but had not yet been fortified to see how important the mission is.

“Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee”: the Lord sent a search party for you; he knew since the womb what he created. “Before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations”: I hired you to be a prophet.

“Ah, Lord God! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.” Lord, this work is too mighty for me; I don’t know much, I’m weak, I ain’t nobody. Most of our brothers have that same weak spirit, and you have to shake it off. The little that you know, if you mastered Deuteronomy 28 and smashing John 3:16, the Lord can use; give him something to work with.

“Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.” Stop making excuses: we are bound to speak it. “Be not afraid of their faces”: didn’t we just read that in Ezekiel? It is the same task and the same mission. “For I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the Lord”: the power that is with us is great, unstoppable. That is going into the men: gird up your loins.

It is not just the men. The sisters need the same spirit our foremother Judith had, not sitting on their hands just having babies. “Judith cried with a loud voice”: so the sisters have to cry with a loud voice. They may not be going out on the corners, but they need to be praying for the prophets, for the children to get their minds right, and for our nation to rise up.

“O Lord God of my father Simeon, to whom thou gavest a sword to take vengeance of the strangers”: this is a sister saying, Lord, take vengeance on the nations. That goes to Simeon and Levi when they destroyed the nations for Dinah. “Wherefore thou gavest their rulers to be slain, so that they dyed their bed in blood”: she is thinking of Psalm 149. “And hast given their wives for a prey, and their daughters to be captives”: she is thinking of Isaiah 14. “And all their spoils to be divided among thy dear children”: all their money and lands given back to the nation of Israel.

She is not praying no Hail Mary; she is praying for vengeance on the nations. “O God, O my God, hear me also a widow.” So sisters need to be praying like no other, sweating three times a day, asking the Lord to bring vengeance on the nations, teaching the kids, doing on their side what we are doing on ours.

Our forefather was thrown in a pit too. “Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah”, and “in the dungeon there was no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.” Mire is dung, crap: the same as Bobby Seale standing in what came up out of the hole. It is scriptural; it is not far-fetched.

Then “Ebed–melech the Ethiopian” spoke to the king: “these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet”, “and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is”. The Lord made a way for him, the same way a brother on the night shift brought Huey sandwiches in the hole. So brothers who are correction officers, do not use your position to abuse your brothers; a true revolutionary in there might depend on you for a piece of bread. That is why we fast often: rehearsing for Jacob’s trouble.

Jeremiah had set himself: I am not going to hold back my tongue; I have to warn the king despite my life. A messenger who steps before the king with unpleasant words may forfeit his life on the spot.

sense.text:
Look at the UFC champion, Khamzat Chimaev, visiting an orphanage, his smile turning to tears when a little girl told him her whole family had been killed in war. The accolades and money did not matter anymore; what mattered was the state of his people, and his face began to be hardened. Those are the ones the Lord is looking for. There are moments we delight in our wives, children and the brotherhood, but we are on kingdom business.

“Set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.” They understand the state of the people and they cry; they do not hold their peace or hold back. That is a mark set on the servants of the Lord.

See Bishop Kana and Bishop Nathanyel in Haiti, surrounded on all corners, five, six, seven flights down in the middle of a voodoo fest, teaching the commandments in the rain, and the men on the streets: who the hell you think going to fix it if you men don’t fix it? and at the Million Man March: you put one of us to death, the next man is going to rise up. If one of us is taken out, the other has to stand in his place. The Bible is our banner, and we cannot let it fall to the ground. In Kenya the brothers got stoned and went back; in Cuba Captain Abiel and the bishops were arrested and the next man grabbed the mic.

This faith cannot be faked; you have to grow into that spirit, saturated with the words of the Lord, through the trials and the counsels. The fake spirit gets exposed. And the brothers out there in adultery and porn cannot sigh and cry for nobody; get your life together or be put to shame before the congregation.

precepts.why:
The flyers were stuffed into the trees and they tried to put their voodoo on us, but we understand the scriptures: it does not work. “Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel.” Voodoo is enchantment, roots, black magic. It does not work on us.

But step outside of the zone and use that yourself, and you will be bugged out of your mind. And a lot of our people are into the zodiac signs: that is divination, against God’s commandments.

“Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?” Which one of our men will stand up and correct evil when they see it? That is what the Lord is looking for: the mark on them that sigh and cry.

The workers of iniquity are criminals, because sin is breaking his laws. He is asking who will step up and contend with them, be the example of praising our God, upholding the customs of God, the ceremonial laws, and the integrity of the moral laws. And the Lord brings those same revolutionary souls back through the generations and cleanses them with the word.

“Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence. When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O Lord, held me up.” The Lord gives the assignment and protects us. “Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?” The man of sin is always finding new ways to contend against us and seduce the children of Israel.

sense.text: Christ warned us of this, which is why we have no fear: we are turned into another man, and it is Christ dwelling in us doing his work. “They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.” “And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.”

“But these things have I told you”: Christ pre-warned us, so it is not going to be shocking to those in the spirit. It is the professional students, who do not study day and night, who are shaken when their number is called. “That when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them.”

We have to be fortified, our face harder than the wicked, as an adamant stone, and not only against the wicked of the nations but the wicked of our people. What hardens us is the scripture we will not deviate from: yes, I am an Israelite, Christ is black, these are our laws and customs. They have think tanks to convince you it is a fantasy, and that the circumcision they give an infant is the custom; it is an abomination, not the circumcision of the scriptures.

“See that ye be not troubled”: do not be dismayed. “For all these things must come to pass”: it cannot be stopped. This nation is set on a self-destructive course.

“For nation shall rise against nation”: Iran, Israel, America, China, Lebanon being bombed. “And there shall be famines, and pestilences.” We are getting a heads up from the Lord: get your pantries up. The bishops, deacons and captains have been warning you.
“All these are the beginning of sorrows.” We are working on that golden ticket, the kingdom.

“Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations.” You saw in the video all those nations; they know the wrong they did against us. And the Lord has a way of reminding all oppressors of their evil just before he kills them, as in the Wisdom of Solomon, sending them terrors at night and blackening the whole land.

precepts.why:
Hear how Moses spoke to Pharaoh. “Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence.” At other times the Lord hardened his heart, because he wanted to show his wonderful power.

“Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt.” At first it was who made you ruler over us?; Moses was dismayed and had to run after he stood up for his people. Now he came back a hero for his people, empowered by the one true God.

“And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die”, “And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt”. “But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue”, “that ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.” He showed favoritism for his people. When they say God loves everybody: he personally came down and killed another nation for his people, so the world would know he chooses his people.

“And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.” Moses dropped the mic: this is the last one; you did not listen about the frogs and the blood. That is the boldness of a servant of the Lord.

“Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.” So some of the wicked have to go; do not feel sorry for them. Do your mission, teach and prophesy. All they had to do was repent and listen to his servants on the corners. He is doing the same with America, hardening their hearts; they do not give a damn about black and Hispanic America and want to eliminate those they cannot use. But there is a powerful God with a mission for us, and we have to take that tone and not be afraid.

sense.text:
When you hear the word and then see the atrocities, some decline and rub hands with the enemy. Kanye West declared that the media is controlled and called himself of the tribes of Israel, then apologized and blamed bipolar disorder, sitting with his hands in submission. He was dismayed because he had roots in Babylon. You opened your mouth and declared yourself to keep this gospel: you cannot go back.

“If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.” If you are still tied in love to family and friends who dishonor God to his face, and walk hand in hand with them, the Lord cannot use you.

“Sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?” He did not count the cost; neither did Nick Cannon, shamed by Candace Owens. And the money: hundreds of millions, the hooks they have in it, and standing to lose it all.

“All that behold it begin to mock him, Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.” You will be mocked; the Lord will set it so you are exposed, like the woke cousin who said don’t invite me to no Fourth of July, now at the cookout eating pork: you take Facebook too serious. That is denying Christ. Some take this as a fad: one season an Israelite, the next gone. Actions shall be weighed.

“Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand? Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage.” Now he is waving the white flag: he did not estimate the overpowering, and he was dismayed. Do not be dismayed by them; stay focused on the mission, harden your face and your spirit constantly, or you will be confounded by the wicked.

precepts.why:
Remember the joy of riding through the hood with the windows down blasting the bishop’s classes; you have to redo it over and over. There will be a plateau, people saying camp 101 is boring, the Sabbath too long, but this is what we signed up for, and what is reserved for the children of light our minds cannot fathom. The gospel is our profession.

“Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering.” Former Israelites came into the comments mocking us for teaching not to keep Easter: to them it was a fad, church, not their life. We jeopardize our lives and are watched constantly, with laws being made to come against us. They will put you in a dark room and say, just leave the Bible on the table and walk out. Do that and you have denied Christ and given up your keys to the kingdom.

Read of the prophets of old: the message was a burden urging them on; they paid the price of long and earnest meditation, counting the cost, and used past, present and future events to enforce their teaching, students in the school of God. Elijah founded a circle of disciples who raised their voices against the perversions of the mighty, and Elisha placed himself at their head at the beginning of his career and followed closely in the footsteps of his master. That is our career and our profession, and why the young brothers must come to the school and be around wise men, not fools.

sense.text: “The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” That is what you see our leadership doing today: prophesying against many kingdoms. We are in Ecuador, Haiti, Puerto Rico; this gospel cannot be stopped, and the mission must continue.

“The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the Lord hath truly sent him.” You shall be revealed when the mission is accomplished. We have been warning this country over and over; those who take heed will say, this prophet was amongst us, doing his job. So we continue this mission, continually hardening our faces against the wicked.

precepts.why: “They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me. Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.” That is our forefather Jeremiah in the dungeon, in the pit. The prophets of old went through it, and so we all have to go through that. Write that precept down.
